summary: The `no_valid_comparison` closure stands. Table S6 reports the diet effect across 15 wild-type and 17 knockout males. The registered contrast uses only the 7 chow-fed and 8 HFD-fed wild-type males. All 31 source files matched their recorded sizes and SHA-256 hashes, and all six computed claims reproduced. The corrected proposal restores the missing legacy source-manifest flag and clarifies that effect concordance remains unassessed because the authors did not report a wild-type-specific diet effect. [Publisher’s supplementary tables](https://ars.els-cdn.com/content/image/1-s2.0-S2772408523001084-mmc2.xlsx)
openIssues: A wild-type HFD-versus-chow author result, or an author-fitted model with documented contrast coding, would reopen the comparison.
